option_relations.rationale: Cerebral Cavernous Malformations (CCM) is a broader category that includes Familial cerebral cavernous malformation type 1 (CCM1) with cutaneous venous malformations.
Venous Malformation Syndrome is a general term and does not specifically refer to the genetic condition described by the leaf.
Familial cerebral cavernous malformations is a broader category that includes Familial cerebral cavernous malformation type 1 (CCM1) with cutaneous venous malformations.

Cerebral Cavernous Malformation (CCM1) is a broader category that includes Familial cerebral cavernous malformation type 1 (CCM1) with cutaneous venous malformations, which specifies the familial aspect and cutaneous manifestations.
